sloka: अथ विजयमवाप्य वानरेन्द्रः समरमुखे सुरयक्षसिद्धसङ्घैः।अवनितलगतैश्च भूतसङ्घैर्हरुषसमाकुलितैः स्तुतो महात्मा ।। ६.९८.३९ ।।
transliteration: atha vijayamavāpya vānarendraḥ samaramukhe surayakṣasiddhasaṅghaiḥ।avanitalagataiśca bhūtasaṅghairharuṣasamākulitaiḥ stuto mahātmā ।। 6.98.39 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas became dull and piteous with sad faces. Out of fear they ran.
